hypothesis: Accumulating contradictory local evidence over multiple witnessed consequences with hysteresis and inactive-bank preservation reduces noisy false switching while retaining causal B on recurrence. Must beat fit-selected fully online HMM, not just old KNOW36.

source.law_bits: reuse fixed KNOW36 A/B1/B2 Boolean laws
source.public_tape: x=(t%8) XOR ((((t//8)%2))<<1); 16 (context,action) each block and x visits twice
source.phases: A[0,64) B[64,128) A[128,192) B[192,256); A-only sham counterpart
source.action_information_fairness: all arms see only t,x,y; no law/phase/seed/score; equal observed trajectories and action counts
source.first_use: One synthetic source-only held first use strictly AFTER focused dual-OS, atlas, full-final dual-OS, historical compatibility, exact Git blob checks; never local unit tests. No rerun if uncertain/consumed.

mechanism.bank_betas: Beta(1,1) initialized, update ACTIVE bank only from actual consequences; max 6 updates/cell/bank; frozen after 6; inactive never receives writes
mechanism.evidence: per group six most recent observed log[p(y|OTHER cell's Beta)/p(y|ACTIVE cell's Beta)] terms, append after observed y; log ratios clamped to [-3,+3] per witness; other bank initially uninformed Beta(1,1)
mechanism.switch: when group has >=3 of last six log-ratio terms >0 and sum of six terms >=4.0, AND 6 observed group events since previous switch; require active bank has >=6 updates on observed x before evaluating evidence; after switch clear evidence and set cooldown to six observed pair events
mechanism.readout: current active bank per adjacent pair, no phase/global regime oracle
mechanism.checkpoint: canonical JSON checksum; <=4096 bytes; cold readout preservation at t64/128/192/256

controls.hmm: Unmodified KNOW36 Comparator('hmm'), 16 continuous Beta heads with global 2-state Markov posterior; hazard chosen once from {1/128,1/32,1/8} on separate FIT seeds using mean t64..255 expected prequential Brier
controls.random: same candidate two-bank slots and evidence-ring checkpoint budget; replace threshold gate with seed- and law-blind SHA256(t,x) mod 32 ==0 after active six x samples, with 6 pair-observation cooldown
controls.no_switch: same candidate state but never change active bank; contrasts added bank/storage versus actually retrieving it
controls.legacy: unchanged original KNOW35 TwoBankCells, no retune, plus conventional rolling last8
controls.cost: Report per-method checkpoint bytes, observation cost and historical-source compatibility; storage/compute not exactly equal across HMM; do not claim fair efficiency win without matched operations.

metrics.score: Expected prequential Brier = q*(1-q)+(p-q)^2 for witnessed x, q scoring-only, pre-update; smaller better
metrics.primary: B recurrence t192..255 cohort mean and per-world wins candidate versus FIT-selected HMM and matched random; B1/B2 independently
metrics.additional: B first, A return, A-prefix, both bank bytes/readout retention, sham false switches, source events, cold rehydration, state bytes, observations costs

frozen_hypotheses.P0: Exact source/arm counts, FIT/HELD disjoint, all public 16 pairs and 8 x every 16, first-use and cold checks pass
frozen_hypotheses.P1: A-prefix Brier <=0.23 for each held B1/B2 cohort (genuine learning)
frozen_hypotheses.H1: Candidate B recurrence mean Brier <= FIT HMM -0.005 in BOTH B cohorts, and >=9/12 paired wins separately each
frozen_hypotheses.H2: Candidate B recurrence mean Brier <= matched random -0.005 and <= no_switch -0.005 in BOTH cohorts
frozen_hypotheses.H3: A-return mean Brier candidate <= FIT HMM+0.005 in BOTH cohorts
frozen_hypotheses.H4: Old A bank at t64 byte-stable through t192 for all 24 worlds AND learned B bank at t128 byte-stable through t192 for all 24; functional cold restore at all boundaries
frozen_hypotheses.H5: A-only sham has <=2/24 worlds with any false bank switches and all candidate checkpoints <=4096 bytes
frozen_hypotheses.decision: DEVELOPMENT_SUPPORTED iff P0,P1,H1,H2,H3,H4,H5 all true, else DEVELOPMENT_MIXED_OR_NO_GO; SCIENCE_NO_GO_SYNTHETIC_NOT_NATIVE always; no accepted model promotion
frozen_hypotheses.stops: Reject/restrain mechanism on frozen negative. No post-result threshold changes, no seed replacement, no outcome-peeking, no replay of consumed KNOW36/KNOW37. Protected original-world and native checkpoint unchanged.
